_about: One entry per published LumeBook Instagram carousel: what it is and where its slides are. Metrics come from the Meta exports (src/audit.py import); never type a metric here except the hand counts under 'manual'. Hook fields of Carousel Machine posts are read from pipeline_run/approved.json at build time, so they are not repeated here. Facts from Yarin's answers of 24 Oct 2026: no carousel was boosted, used in an ad or posted as a collab; some went to Stories; no link had a UTM.

_fields.shortcode: the code in the permalink, instagram.com/p/<shortcode>/; joins this entry to the export
_fields.slides_dir: folder of the posted PNGs (trust these over approved.json: the 8 Oct slide says גן, approved.json says לומי)
_fields.pipeline_run: Carousel Machine run folder, or null for posts made outside it
_fields.family: kid, expert, reco (games and books), story (customer story), advice (parent-facing advice made before the pipeline)
_fields.hook_appeal: emotional, educational or mixed (the cover line, not the whole post)
_fields.hook_structure: plain-words label of the cover line's shape, used to group posts
_fields.motivation: the parent motivation the post speaks to
_fields.product_focus: value-first (book only as the closing idea), product list (book as one item of a list), product proof (the real book in use)
_fields.picture_style: how the pictures work across the slides
_fields.text_weight: light (mostly headlines), medium (headline plus one or two lines), heavy (three lines or more on several slides)
_fields.cta_type: code word, bio link, save + comment question; 'mixed' when slide and caption ask for different things
_fields.manual: hand counts Instagram does not export: parent_comments excludes LumeBook's own replies; code_word_people counts distinct accounts; orders_matched stays null until someone checks the admin
